goals.outcome: Create versioned charter and capability/support-envelope records naming first customer, Shopify-first/WooCommerce-second scope, actions, payment/fulfillment exclusions and release claims; obtain human approval.

non_goals: Do not implement later milestones or expand the approved capability envelope.
Do not lower accepted thresholds, delete/skip/reidentify tests, change expected fixtures to fit faulty behavior, or self-approve baseline changes.

prerequisites: Inspect the actual repository, installed workflow and accepted dependency evidence before writing code.
Resolve proposed module/test locations and bind the goal to existing commands; no invented executable commands or preclaimed application tests.
Use a dedicated worktree and isolated data/services; preserve the protected baseline and minimize sensitive evidence.
An authorized human supplies the approval/decision. The worker may draft options and checks, but cannot impersonate the decision-maker.
worker_steps: Read this goal, linked original criteria and currently accepted dependency evidence; inspect the real code and installed git-agent conventions.
Bind the scope and stable test IDs to existing files/commands; identify impacted accepted capabilities and agree the independent oracle.
Write the smallest behavioral tests/fixtures first; capture a meaningful red result or valid targeted fault for existing behavior.
Implement only the bounded outcome in the isolated worktree; keep production and unapproved provider egress disabled.
Run new tests, impacted old tests and protected cross-cutting invariants; execute required authorized connected/independent qualification without inventing results.
Capture the exact candidate evidence, update documentation/rollback notes and submit independent security plus regression review.
Fix findings, recapture changed-candidate evidence and request trusted acceptance. If blocked, report the precise unmet prerequisite, not done.
acceptance_criteria: Validate a named supported order-status and return scenario against the approved matrix => Every scenario resolves to a supported, conditional or explicitly excluded capability with a reason and accountable owner.
Introduce a refund/payment combination absent from the envelope => Validation rejects an automatic supported label and requires a reviewed scope decision.
Remove an already accepted capability from the matrix => Baseline comparison detects the removal and blocks an unchanged release claim.

tests/native-report.* and tests/results.json: exact commands/exit codes, discovered and executed stable case IDs, totals and native report hashes; zero-test/skip/todo is not pass.
red-green.md: observed behavioral red failure or valid targeted mutant failure, repaired-candidate pass, and the exact code/config change that caused each outcome.
demo.md plus sanitized API trace or UI recording: demonstrate the named outcome on this candidate; screenshots alone do not establish money or stock correctness.

source_requirements.title: Define one remote trust profile over current task authority
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
The contract names one supported profile, trusted configuration sources, token/key binding and identity-to-task mapping; each field has an explicit trusted source or server lookup.
Two synthetic tenants using the same public task shape still resolve to different permitted resources; forged tenant, customer, role or task claims cannot increase authority.
Local opaque and remote profiles have separate validation paths and truthful compatibility labels. Selecting an unsupported issuer or confirmation mechanism leaves remote access disabled.

goals.outcome: Specify a remote identity and sender-binding contract whose only authority comes from verified issuer claims and existing server-side task permissions.
scope: Define a narrow RemoteTaskAuthenticator result containing trusted issuer and audience, original principal and current actor, sender-key thumbprint, token expiry, task ceiling and an internal server-resolved task scope.

Configure an exact issuer, allowed signing algorithms and key sources, resource audience, canonical HTTPS origin, accepted confirmation mechanism and bounded clock/replay windows. Do not select issuer, key URL or audience from arbitrary client input.

Map the authenticated principal to current tenant, store, customer/case and permitted operations using existing server state. Treat caller-supplied identifiers as requested resources, not evidence of membership.

Select the RFC 9449 DPoP resource-server profile and an existing supported issuer/library integration. If the selected issuer cannot issue or confirm sender-bound tokens, leave that remote profile unavailable.
Keep the current loopback-only opaque read grant and local worker contract explicit. A configured remote profile must never reinterpret a local grant as OAuth.

No new business action, remote agent approval authority, approval bypass or enlargement of the current supported commerce envelope.

No full MCP protocol-version migration in this milestone. Start with the existing worker HTTP reads and proposal-preparation contract; expose remote MCP only after its own transport/profile compatibility evidence.
No guarantee about an external agent host's key protection, storage, inference, deletion or network egress merely because Rifare accepts sender proofs.
No claim that DPoP binds a request body or approves its business semantics, and no compliance or Cloudflare certification claim.

Treat milestone dependencies as integration and qualification dependencies. Local contract, fixture and implementation work may proceed under its normal assignment while formal prerequisite acceptance remains open; it must not report those prerequisite milestones as accepted.

Use signed synthetic issuer fixtures, independent local clients and isolated development storage. Select an actively maintained standards library after checking its documented support; do not implement cryptographic primitives or a new general authorization server.

Follow DEVELOPMENT.md and ADR-0032: inspect the affected-file plan, run a coherent focused selection once, and repeat only for a concrete failure or material correction. source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
A properly bound token and proof reaches the existing permitted read/proposal path; the same token without a proof or with a different sender key is rejected before resource access.
Wrong method, target URI, token hash, token audience, expired proof, disallowed algorithm and an untrusted proxy-origin substitution are rejected with bounded, non-secret diagnostics.
A proof-valid request with a changed amount, query resource or proposed action still undergoes existing permission, schema, policy and exact-preview checks; sender proof grants no business approval.

goals.title: Fence replay, revocation and active work across verifier processes

source_requirements.title: Fence replay, revocation and active work across verifier processes
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
Two verifier processes race the same valid proof against the shared store: at most one request is admitted. A restart within the proof window does not make the proof reusable.
Revoked membership/session, an expired task, a stop revision and a stale lease generation deny the relevant next operation or renewal even when the token and cryptographic proof are valid.
Replay-store failure denies protected access and records a bounded reason; recovery restores service without accepting retained replays or reopening expired tasks.
An ambiguous synthetic effect followed by an authenticated takeover remains attached to its original operation identity and proceeds through reconciliation without a second send.

Preserve existing unknown-operation reconciliation semantics: retrying authentication or taking over a lease must not create a fresh identity for an already attempted business effect.

source_requirements.title: Exercise bounded independent-client continuation
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
An independent client reads the permitted synthetic case and prepares a return proposal; a separate authorized operator can review it using the existing manual flow.
Client replacement fences the previous owner's next operation and does not extend the original expiry, add a store or restore revoked permissions.
A requested broader or longer-lived delegated task is rejected or narrowed by the supported issuer/server contract; an unsupported delegation mechanism fails explicitly.
The replacement client receives only its allowed case context, and the compatibility record distinguishes server-enforced scope from unobserved external-host behavior.

source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
With the optional gateway disabled, the supported direct/stub model path and manual workflow remain available under the same broker authority, and no Cloudflare credential or service is required.
For a selected optional profile, synthetic wire evidence shows the exact trusted logging/cache/route/billing settings; unauthorized header overrides and provider/billing fallback are rejected.
A live-qualified gateway claim requires observed behavior on the named route for allowed content, a blocked synthetic sensitive-input case and a provider failure; unavailable features or unexercised streaming/media paths remain explicitly unqualified.

scope: Coordinate with the M14 provider/decision contract. Own the trusted gateway policy profile and enforcement observations; do not duplicate the decision adapter or require gateway usage.

Pin account/gateway/model-route identity, authorized provider destinations, credential references, billing mode, fallback behavior, budgets, payload/metadata logging, retention and cache behavior in trusted configuration.

For the first optional Cloudflare profile, use bounded text and nonstreaming responses; prefer metadata-only gateway logging with cf-aig-collect-log-payload:false, disable sensitive response caching initially and prevent unapproved billing/provider fallback.

Document the actual product boundary: DLP is text-scoped; cache hits may avoid rescanning; unsupported response types and some streaming paths have different enforcement behavior. Qualify the selected route instead of claiming universal guardrail coverage.

Use separate gateway instances where tenant policies cannot safely share gateway-wide settings. Prevent clients or prompts from overriding trusted policy headers, routes or data destinations.

Allow three honest outcomes: disabled/not requested, locally configured with synthetic wire evidence, or live-qualified for one named route. Absence of a gateway does not fail M16's core isolation/graph result or the manual path.

goals.title: Prepare supplies replenishment and gate recurring purchases

source_requirements.title: Prepare supplies replenishment and gate recurring purchases
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
Without an explicitly active mandate capability, a threshold or schedule creates only one explainable PO draft. Repeated observations, open POs and partial receipts cannot duplicate the same uncovered need or authorize a supplier call.
When the optional path is separately qualified, a principal with M11-G06 procurement approval authority approves its versioned mandate terms, preserving required separation of duties. The proposing or executing agent cannot activate or widen it. Each occurrence rechecks current mandate and authorizing authority, fixed merchant/supplier/SKU terms, stock and open-PO evidence, exact purchase preview, approved quantities and atomic per-order/aggregate spend reservations. Covered changes require new approval.
A timeout after supplier acceptance keeps the original mandate occurrence and purchase identity unknown. Its unresolved stock/order commitment and applicable mandate/budget reservations persist across timeout, restart, mandate expiry and later triggers until authoritative reconciliation or cancellation resolves the outcome. Retries reconcile the original identity; another occurrence cannot consume the same committed need or reserved capacity.
Revocation, expiry, changed supplier or price outside approved bounds before dispatch blocks the recurring effect and preserves a draft/exception. The evidence states whether only drafts or actual qualified mandate execution was observed.

source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
The browser remains responsive through loading and cancellation; no model download begins merely because the ordinary commerce view opens, and an unapproved or corrupt artifact never reaches a ready state.
An actual target browser can load, warm and unload the approved pack, or records a concrete unsupported/unavailable reason. A mocked adapter, navigator.gpu presence or successful file download alone cannot qualify inference.
A cache hit verifies artifact identity and still records initialization; cache eviction, interrupted transfer and insufficient storage yield a recoverable state without an uncontrolled re-download loop.
GPU allocation failure, device loss or a CPU fallback that cannot fit the pack leaves the existing manual workflow available and releases resources when possible, with no automatic hosted inference.

goals.title: Apply purpose, privacy, cancellation and destination rules

source_requirements.title: Apply purpose, privacy, cancellation and destination rules
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
The declared local-only inference demonstration contains no model-input request to a hosted inference service; model downloads and authorized Rifare traffic are identified separately and carry no case text in model URLs or telemetry.
Model failure leaves manual handling available. A hosted or self-hosted inference fallback requires an already approved current destination/purpose and explicit configured selection; it uses a new authorized server invocation rather than laundering a client result.
Logout, tenant switch, correction, revocation or deadline invalidates pending ingestion and disposes controlled client state as specified; reopening a tab or replaying an old result cannot restore erased or superseded observations.
The privacy inventory names client memory, any enabled cache and server observation stores; controlled cleanup/export checks have evidence, and inaccessible external copies remain an explicit limit rather than a deletion attestation.
source_requirements.contribution: This browser requirement closes only with its exact frozen criteria, mapped worker evidence and formal milestone gate; local preparation is not acceptance.

goals.outcome: Keep browser computation within the approved data purpose and make cancellation, local cleanup and any fallback explicit without transferring authority or evidence silently.
scope: Declare browser-local inference, ordinary Rifare evidence retrieval/observation submission, model artifact downloads and any separately selected server provider as distinct data destinations. A local model load failure is not permission to upload case text elsewhere.

Minimize client state, prohibit case evidence in artifact URLs and telemetry, and disable persistent evidence/prefix caching by default. If an approved cache is later retained, scope it to tenant, actor/session, purpose and exact evidence/configuration revisions with the existing erasure owner.

Wire abort, deadline, ownership change, evidence correction, logout, tenant switch and page/worker termination into cancellation and late-result fencing. Use current server checks on any resumed or offline proposal; client cancellation is not proof that the GPU stopped instantly.

Reuse privacy export/erasure/restore suppression for server client-observation records, and provide client cache/worker disposal for the stores Rifare controls. Keep public weight caches distinct from customer-derived data; do not claim secure erasure of malicious-client memory, screenshots or exported copies.

source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
Both named browser engines actually execute the same frozen cohort; mocks, a single engine with two wrappers or a previously imported result do not satisfy the paired comparison.
Results report the declared denominators, failures, unknowns and differences, with no tolerance, quality target or winner rule invented after data. Failed goals stay failed or pending under the original protocol.
Any task-confidence threshold is qualified per engine/precision/question profile using the M14 process; numerical agreement or compressed file size alone cannot transfer thresholds or imply a quality improvement.

goals.title: Qualify a compatible vision companion and decision API path

source_requirements.title: Qualify a compatible vision companion and decision API path
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
The manifest proves that the selected vision companion, decoder, processor and trained head belong to the same supported model/configuration; a mismatched companion is rejected before inference.
A real browser request reaches the image-aware joint decision computation with all requested questions, or the capability stays unqualified. General runtime image support cannot substitute for this observation.
Pinned reference checks cover image preprocessing/position or span mapping and complete typed outputs within predeclared tolerance; text-only execution that ignores the supplied image fails the capability check.
The existing text Kevala path and M13 v1 text contract retain their behavior; image support uses an explicit M17-governed extension and does not implicitly enable audio/video.

goals.title: Process exact authorized image bytes under explicit bounds

source_requirements.title: Process exact authorized image bytes under explicit bounds
source_requirements.original_acceptance_criteria:
Substitution of another case, image version, expired grant or changed content fails preparation or ingestion; a caller-supplied digest alone cannot establish authoritative attachment provenance.
Malformed/unsupported images, decompression-size excess and input/context overflow fail within declared resource bounds rather than becoming an apparently valid result on partial evidence.
The observation identifies the authorized original and declared transformation/configuration, with missing or unobservable client details labeled reported/unknown and no claim of authenticated inference.
An image omitted from the executed request or an undeclared transformation cannot be represented as a qualified image observation; source evidence and manual review remain available according to the existing M17 policy.

goals.outcome: Pass only the permitted image version through bounded decoding and preprocessing while preserving evidence provenance and typed decision limits.
scope: Use M17 media handles/grants and content-version checks to obtain permitted bytes; keep caller-supplied URLs, arbitrary filesystem paths and hidden third-party fetches outside the inference API.

Declare supported decoder behavior, orientation/color/alpha normalization, resizing/cropping, encoded and decoded size limits, image count and token/context budgets. Link derived pixel/embedding inputs to the original content hash and preprocessing version.

Keep material transformations explicit and do not silently drop, crop or truncate required evidence to make a request fit. Use a review/unavailable result when the selected image plus text/questions exceeds the qualified profile.

Normalize typed outputs through the retained decision rules and M23 client-observation boundary. The server may verify its media record and authorization but cannot prove an untrusted browser processed those pixels or ran the model.

Correction, erasure, revocation or tenant switch during asynchronous image processing prevents accepting the late proposal, including after a tab is suspended and resumed.
